messages:
Ravi S.: Quick sync: we need to pick prioritization for burst-shaping features for Dedicated roadmap. Options: 1) predictive headroom, 2) tenant opt-in micro-pools, 3) guaranteed no-preempt add-on.
Tess H.: My vote: micro-pools first. low-risk to implement and gives customers a clear isolation path.
Miguel A.: Micro-pools add infra overhead. predictive headroom gives better global efficiency but is harder. Maybe staged: micro-pools MVP + telemetry, then predictive.
Oncall - Priya: Ops: if we do micro-pools, require an admission backfill policy to avoid starvation. also monitoring per-pool fairness needed.
Ravi S.: Good point. Proposal: MVP micro-pools limited to top-tier customers, with admission fairness and a backfill throttle. GA roadmap adds predictive headroom and a commercial "no-preempt" SKU.
Legal - Dana: For no-preempt SKU we need contract language and escalation commitments. also clarify credit policy if preempt happens despite guarantees.
Tess H.: Launch checklist draft: 1) micro-pool config UI + API 2) admission/backfill policy implemented 3) fairness telemetry + dashboard 4) pilot with 2 customers 5) contract appendix for opt-in add-ons.
Miguel A.: Timeline: micro-pools MVP in 2 sprints if eng priority green. predictive headroom is ~4-5 sprints.
Ravi S.: Action items: @Tess own product PR, @Miguel scope infra impact, @Priya ops runbook for backfill, @Dana draft contract appendix. We'll present to PM leadership Wednesday.
Tess H.: 👍 will start the PR and link a short design doc.
